paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 2.64, representing a decrease of 0.3 percent from the prior close and 45.19 percent over the last 23 sessions. The price is as of October 23, 2026.

There have been no new news headlines in the last 24 hours, but a recent news article from Seeking Alpha on October 21, 2026, reported that Fermi's CEO outlined a capital strategy in a shareholder letter, which caused the stock to rise. The letter detailed a three-part capital strategy for the Project Matador energy and AI facility in Texas.

Recent filings include a Form 4 insider transaction report on October 23, 2026, and a Form 144 notice of proposed sale on October 21, 2026. Additionally, an 8-K filing on October 16, 2026, announced an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd. There have also been 3 new social posts in the last 24 hours, including discussions about buying into FRMI.
